description: For every relation symbol \(R\), including a nullary symbol, \(R^{\prod_{\mathcal U}M_i}([f_0],\ldots,[f_{r-1}])\) holds exactly when \(\{i:R^{M_i}(f_0(i),\ldots,f_{r-1}(i))\}\in\mathcal U\).
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.relMap_quotient_mk'.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type u_1} (s : Setoid M)
  [ps : L.Prestructure s] {n : ℕ} (r : L.Relations n) (x : Fin n → M) :
  (FirstOrder.Language.Structure.RelMap r fun i => ⟦x i⟧) ↔ FirstOrder.Language.Structure.RelMap r x
